atoms.name: Page header, address and hours
atoms.goal: The page shows the shop name, the address and the opening hours exactly as given in the charter.

how.steps: Create index.html with doctype, head, viewport meta and a body. Add section #hero holding h1 #shop-name (Bean There), p #address (1 Example Road) and p #hours (7am-6pm daily).

constraints: Create only #hero, #shop-name, #address and #hours
Show only facts from the charter; no phone, email or extra items
Include doctype, head and viewport meta

defined_output.text: Name, address and hours are shown

atoms.name: Menu section
atoms.goal: The page lists espresso £2.50, flat white £3.20 and croissant £2.80 as a menu.

how.steps: Add section #menu after #hero with a heading and a list of exactly three li.menu-item entries. Each shows the item name and its price together as espresso £2.50, flat white £3.20 and croissant £2.80.

constraints: Create only #menu and the .menu-item entries
Exactly three items; no invented items
Prices in pounds exactly as given
Other sections stay unchanged

atoms.name: Responsive layout styles
atoms.goal: The page has no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px and is readable on phones and desktop.

how.steps: Add one style element #page-style in the head. Wrap the body content in div.page-wrap with max-width and padding. Use box-sizing border-box, fluid widths, overflow-wrap and readable type sizes so nothing exceeds the viewport.

constraints: Create only style block #page-style and wrapper .page-wrap
Use box-sizing border-box, fluid widths and wrapping
Do not change any text or facts

atoms.name: Navigation and script integrity
atoms.goal: Every in-page link points to an existing section and the page runs with no JavaScript errors.

how.steps: Add nav #site-nav with three links to #hero, #hours and #menu, each at least 44px tall. Add a minimal script #page-script that does nothing that can throw. Keep ids #hero, #hours and #menu in place.

constraints: Create only nav #site-nav and script #page-script
Links only to #hero, #hours and #menu
Script minimal and error-free
No horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px
Nav links at least 44px tall

defined_output.text: Nav links are big enough to tap

atoms.name: Complete landing page
atoms.goal: One page shows the shop name, address, opening hours and a three-item menu with prices exactly as given, with working in-page navigation, no script errors and no horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px.

how.steps: Create index.html only, with doctype, head, viewport meta and one style element #page-style. In the body add div.page-wrap holding nav #site-nav with three links to #hero, #hours and #menu, each at least 44px tall. Add section #hero with h1 #shop-name (Bean There) and p #address (1 Example Road). Add section #hours with p #hours-text (7am-6pm daily) and give the element with id #hours as that section. Add section #menu with a heading and a list of exactly three li.menu-item entries: espresso £2.50, flat white £3.20, croissant £2.80. Style with fluid widths, max-width, padding, overflow-wrap and readable contrast. Add a minimal script #page-script that cannot throw. Write no other file.

constraints: Write only index.html in the workflow's own folder; touch no other file
Create only #hero, #shop-name, #address, #hours, #menu, .menu-item, #site-nav, #page-style, .page-wrap and #page-script
Show only facts from the charter; no phone, email or extra menu items
Exactly three .menu-item entries; prices in pounds exactly as given
Nav links go only to #hero, #hours and #menu, each at least 44px tall
Script minimal and unable to throw
Use box-sizing border-box, fluid widths and wrapping so nothing overflows at 360px or 1280px

defined_output.text: All facts and prices are shown
Nav links are big enough to tap
